youtube.title: 手摸溫涼管子竟然像燙傷？皮膚根本不是溫度計｜原來如此事務所
youtube.description:
20°C 的涼水不燙，40°C 的溫水也不燙，但把通著冷溫水的金屬管交錯排成一排，手掌平貼上去卻會瞬間感到像燙傷般劇烈灼痛！
其實皮膚根本不是忠實報數字的溫度計，而是替大腦蒐集線索的前線偵察兵——從視丘冷覺煞車解除（溫涼格柵錯覺）、額頭比小腿靈敏五倍、冰硬幣貼額頭變重超過 22%（韋伯現象）、水循環服 6°C 舒適遲滯、急遽降溫反常喊熱，到藍色板子反而更容易摸成暖、甚至耳朵光聽倒水聲就能分出冷熱，帶你一次看懂大腦如何跨感官算出你感受到的每一絲溫度！

📚 參考研究與出處：
- 氣候艙 0.38°C / 0.92°C 溫差辨別（Sci Rep 2023）：https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-023-47880-5
- 全身 12 部位熱敏感度地圖（IJERPH 2021）：https://doi.org/10.3390/ijerph182312576
- 四肢冷覺門檻低於暖覺（Clin Neurophysiol Pract 2018）：https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cnp.2018.06.004
- 水循環服 6°C 舒適遲滯（Life 2021）：https://doi.org/10.3390/life11070681
- 急遽降溫反常熱感（Commun Psychol 2024）：https://doi.org/10.1038/s44271-024-00083-8
- 高強度運動後前臂暖覺鈍化（IJERPH 2020）：https://doi.org/10.3390/ijerph17072491
- 熱轉移錯覺（Sci Rep 2016）：https://doi.org/10.1038/srep35286
- 溫涼格柵錯覺（Biol Sex Differ 2017）：https://doi.org/10.1186/s13293-017-0147-5
- 視丘特異活化 fMRI（PLoS ONE 2011）：https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0027075
- 韋伯現象低溫變重（BMC Neurosci 2017）：https://doi.org/10.1186/s12868-016-0322-3
- 冰物抓握力增加 10.4%（Exp Brain Res 2020）：https://doi.org/10.1007/s00221-020-05794-y
- 藍紅面板與手部投影反轉（Sci Rep 2014）：https://doi.org/10.1038/srep05527
- 紅藍環境光認知負荷（Sci Rep 2024）：https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-024-71784-7
- 聽倒水聲辨冷熱與 94.5% 機器學習（Front Psychol 2024）：https://doi.org/10.3389/fpsyg.2024.1353490

scenes.chapter: 冷溫管並排，竟然摸出燙傷感？

data.prompt: Medium wide shot inside the bright sunny Taiwanese office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, holding a frosted cool glass in her left hand and a gently steaming warm glass in her right hand, looking puzzled toward camera.

lines.text: 所長！通著冷溫水的金屬管分開摸都不燙，交錯並排一起摸竟像燙傷般痛到縮手，怎麼回事？

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 冷管二十度像涼水，溫管四十度像泡澡水，合起來沒多出一絲熱量，手掌也毫髮無傷。

data.prompt: Close-up dramatic view of an open five-fingered palm recoiling inches above a metal rack of alternating frosted rods and warm glowing rods, vivid coral sensory sparks leaping upward.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 更離奇的是，你平時連不到半度溫差都分得出，偏偏面對這排安全金屬管竟徹底誤判！

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the cozy sunlit office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi Taiwanese office chief woman with generous headroom, dark brown-black low side ponytail with silver-grey streak, round black glasses, warm brown aligned eyes, bare clean ears, mustard-yellow knitted cardigan over white shirt, dark navy trousers, five clean fingers, sitting behind an oak desk with a small brushed-metal grill prop, leaning forward with an intrigued smile.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 而且別以為皮膚本身就多可靠——這次是中樞出包，但平時皮膚其實連溫度計都算不上。

data.prompt: Close-up angled view of a sleek metal thermal grill on a dark walnut bench, alternating frosted aluminum bars and warm glowing copper bars arranged in zebra stripes, subtle cool mist and warm shimmer rising.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 今天我們就來聊聊，溫涼管子怎麼騙過大腦造出燙傷感，同時拆穿皮膚根本不是溫度計的真相。

scenes.chapter: 視丘煞車失靈，憑空造出燙傷感

data.prompt: Medium shot in a dim testing room with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, gasping with wide shocked eyes as her hand touches an alternating cool and warm glowing metallic bar grill on the desk.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 沒錯，這叫「溫涼格柵錯覺」——皮膚沒報錯，真正出包的是大腦裡的痛覺煞車被拔掉了！

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 關鍵在通往大腦感覺轉運站「視丘」的兩條神經：第一條是包著絕緣外皮、跑超快的冷覺快線。

data.prompt: Medium shot in a bright cool-toned studio corner with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi Taiwanese office chief woman with generous headroom, dark brown-black low side ponytail with silver-grey streak, round black glasses, warm brown aligned eyes, bare clean ears, mustard-yellow knitted cardigan over white shirt, dark navy trousers, five clean fingers, pointing gently at a glowing coral nerve cord diagram on the desk beside her.

lines.text: 另一條少了絕緣外皮、跑得慢的痛覺線叫 C 纖維，微涼也會叫醒它，一放行就喊燙痛。

data.prompt: Close-up wordless neural mechanism metaphor: a bright fast electric-cyan cool nerve stream extending a glowing clamp-gate firmly locking down a dormant coral pain wire so only calm cool light reaches the brain.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 先記住這道煞車：單摸涼管時，冷覺快線先衝進中樞死死壓住灼痛警報，所以只覺清涼。

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 但一加上交錯排開的溫管，情況瞬間反轉：溫覺訊號在中樞反壓冷覺，直接把煞車拔掉了！

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 沒人踩煞車的灼痛通道瞬間解禁、全力放電，大腦立刻誤判你燙傷，命令手掌馬上縮回。

data.prompt: Medium shot laboratory monitor displaying a sagittal brain cross-section glowing cool silver with intense luminous orange activation flaring deep inside the central thalamus and anterior insula.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 腦部掃描拍到鐵證：單摸都很平靜，唯獨交錯時，視丘痛覺通道與管痛感的前腦島瞬間猛亮。

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 大腦不只誤報燙傷，連沒碰到的地方都會腦補：實驗讓人蒙眼，只將食指無名指貼溫板、中指懸空。

data.prompt: Close-up of an open five-fingered hand from above in a dark lab: glowing warm golden thermal wave arcs leaping from the heated index and ring fingers to paint a vivid translucent warm orange phantom glow across the untouched middle finger between them.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 結果受試者依然強烈覺得懸空的中指也熱了起來——大腦直接把鄰近皮膚的溫度平滑補了上去。

scenes.chapter: 全身測溫一樣準？額頭竟比小腿靈敏五倍

lines.text: 兩間房只差零點三八度，就有七成五的人分得出來；溫差到零點九二度，正確率更衝上九成五。

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunny office near a bright sky window with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, resting her chin thoughtfully near the desk while tapping fingertips together in curious skepticism.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 哇，靈敏度這麼驚人！那全身上下每一塊皮膚，感溫能力至少都差不多厲害吧？

data.prompt: Medium shot inside a bright daylight lab office with mint accents and generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi Taiwanese office chief woman with generous headroom, dark brown-black low side ponytail with silver-grey streak, round black glasses, warm brown aligned eyes, bare clean ears, mustard-yellow knitted cardigan over white shirt, dark navy trousers, five clean fingers, leaning forward with an intrigued expression gesturing toward neat rows of glass trial tokens.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 臉和手最靈敏：額頭只要升溫零點八度就能察覺變暖，手掌則要升高一點一度。

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 但一路往下走到小腿下端和腳背，察覺變暖的門檻竟飆破四點二度，比額頭遲鈍五倍以上！

scenes.chapter: 冰飲料變重？冷熱訊號連肌肉力道都騙
